name: How much does it cost to remove a load-bearing wall?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove a load-bearing wall in a Los Angeles home?
mainEntity.text: How much does it cost to remove a load-bearing wall in a Los Angeles home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a load-bearing wall is rarely priced as a single demolition task. The total cost usually includes engineering, permit fees, temporary shoring, beam or header installation, labor, utility relocation, drywall repair, flooring patching, paint, and inspections. In Los Angeles and nearby cities, older homes often add cost because framing conditions are unknown until the wall is opened. If the opening is wide or the load is heavy, the beam may need to be larger or may require posts, footings, or foundation reinforcement. Projects that seem simple at first can become expensive once electrical, plumbing, or HVAC lines are found inside the wall. A reliable estimate should separate design, permit, structural work, and finish restoration so homeowners can see where the money goes. When comparing contractors, ask what is included, what is excluded, and whether hidden-condition allowances are built into the price.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost can vary widely based on wall length, beam size, engineering, permits, electrical or plumbing rerouting, and finish repairs. Simple wall removals may cost a few thousand dollars, while larger structural openings can cost significantly more once design and construction are included.
